text:
maria-peopleops: Heads up 1: vendor notified about HSA transfer window during our open enrollment cutover (effective 2024-09-01). Two quick questions: 1) are there trustee transfer fees billed to employees? 2) what happens to FSA run-out claims if plan year ends 8/31?
sam-payroll: Quick answers: trustee fees depend on vendor contract; some charge $25 per outgoing transfer, others waive. Payroll doesn't deduct transfer fees unless vendor requests a payroll adjustment and benefits approves. For FSA run-out, if plan has a 90-day run-out, claims through 11/29 are allowed; if it's grace period, it's different. Need plan doc.
jasper-hris: If vendor requires a signed ACH authorization for outgoing transfers that isn't in ADP, we may need employees to e-sign. We can push a bulk enrollment form but need legal sign-off for language.
tarun-legal: Confirming: any fee charged to employees should be documented in plan communications and depends on vendor policy. If employees are charged, we need explicit disclosure before migration. Also check if state notice rules apply (some states require separate notice for benefit vendor changes).
maria-peopleops: Okay I'll ask vendor for their transfer fee policy and any state-specific notices. Sam, what cutoff do you need to process ACH changes for Sept 1 effective date?
sam-payroll: Operationally we need final mapping and ACH test by 8/10 for clean Sept 1 payroll. If later, we can do manual ACH batch but it will delay deposits by 1-2 pay cycles. Also note payroll can only post employer contributions to one trustee per pay period; if both occur in same period we must choose which to credit and do a reconciliation.
jasper-hris: Also check termination flow: if someone separates 8/20, and migration is 9/1, do we stop contributions to old vendor immediately on separation and then do nothing on 9/1? Typically yes, but check how final pay posts.
tarun-legal: Recommend including a short Q&A in employee comms about separation, transfer fees, and claim deadlines. I'll review.
benefits-bot: KB: Vendor change checklist: https://kb.redwood.com/benefits/vendor-change | FSA run-out vs grace FAQ: https://kb.redwood.com/benefits/fsa-runout
maria-peopleops: Action items: 1) I'll request vendor fee policy + state notice requirements (ETA 7/20). 2) Jasper to draft e-sign flow if needed (ETA 7/25). 3) Sam to confirm ACH test format and exact cutoff (ETA 8/5). 4) Tarun to draft disclosure language for comms (ETA 7/22).
sam-payroll: One more technical: preferred CSV headers for mapping: employee_id, last_name, first_name, ssn_last4, birth_date, routing_number, account_number, account_type, contribution_amount, plan_code. Send sample to payroll-team@redwood.com.
maria-peopleops: Thanks everyone 1 :email: I'll post the vendor reply and a draft comms once I have fees and notice details.
